# Airola

> Airbnb and short-let turnover cleaning in East London, with photo proof sent to your WhatsApp after every clean.

## Services

- Standard Turnover from £55 (1-bed), +£20 per extra bedroom: kitchen, bathroom and floors, linen change and bed making (host's clean linen), bins emptied, damage and low-stock check, photo confirmation, no contract
- Premium Turnover from £75 (1-bed), +£20 per extra bedroom: everything in Standard plus dishwashing and kitchen reset, fridge cleaned inside and out and microwave inside, essentials restocked from the host's supplies, priority booking and faster response, pre-check-in double inspection
- Add-ons with Standard Turnover only: essentials restocking £10, dishwashing £10, fridge and microwave £10
- Rebook discount: book the next clean within 7 days of the last clean at the same property and take 10% off that clean, every time (£49.50 Standard, £67.50 Premium for a 1-bed). The first clean at a property is at the full price
- Only one offer applies per clean. The rebook discount does not combine with any other offer, private rate or giveaway credit. Credits apply to future bookings only and cannot be exchanged for cash

## Area

Stratford, Royal Wharf, Canary Wharf, Canning Town, Hackney Wick, Bow, Mile End, Leyton

## Guarantee

First-Clean Guarantee: if the first clean is not guest-ready we re-clean the affected areas free.
